description: Per-payer PA drafting template for one (state, medication) vertical: Massachusetts x fluticasone propionate HFA (generic Flovent HFA, inhaled corticosteroid). Field names under prefill/clinical reference the real AcroForm field names in the captured blank forms (../forms/). valueSource legend: 'app' = derivable now from formulary.json + this template; 'practiceProfile' = prescriber identity saved locally in the browser (localStorage, never sent anywhere); 'patient' = per-patient data typed at draft time and never persisted; 'clinical' = the medical-necessity answers only the prescriber can give.

medication.brandContext: Generic of Flovent HFA (brand discontinued Jan 2024; authorized generic by Prasco). Strengths 44/110/220 mcg per actuation.
medication.typicalSig: 88-220 mcg (1-2 puffs) twice daily; 1 inhaler (~10.6 g) per 30 days

masshealth.scope: Members >= 12 years (aerosol); all ages for powder. MHDL Table 23 + Inhaled Respiratory Agents PA form.

form.title: MassHealth Inhaled Respiratory Agents Prior Authorization Request

submission.mcoNote: Same form; MCO/ACPP routing is printed on form page 1 (Tufts Health Together -> point32health.promptpa.com / fax 617-673-0939; MGB Health Plan -> CoverMyMeds/OptumRx / fax 844-403-1029; WellSense -> wellsense.org portal / fax 833-951-1680; Fallon + HNE -> CoverMyMeds/OptumRx).

prefill.field: Dose and frequency of medication requested
Last name / First name / MI / Date of birth / Member ID / demographics block
Prescriber block (Last name*, First name*, NPI*, Telephone No*, Fax No*, address, e-mail)

prefill.note: select the member's MassHealth plan; drives where the form is faxed

clinicalQuestions.question: Has the member had a trial with two inhaled corticosteroids?
clinicalQuestions.yesPath: List drug, dates/duration, and outcome (adverse reaction / inadequate response) for each trial in Section XI
clinicalQuestions.noPath: Document a contraindication to all other inhaled corticosteroids
clinicalQuestions.appAssist: The app pre-lists this plan's no-PA ICS options as the expected trial drugs: budesonide inhalation powder (Pulmicort Flexhaler), mometasone (Asmanex), fluticasone furoate (Arnuity, brand preferred)

clinicalQuestions.question: Step-therapy exception (four statutory questions: contraindication/harm, expected ineffectiveness, prior trial of same-class alternative, stability on current drug)
clinicalQuestions.appAssist: Only needed when bypassing the Section IV trial requirement; mirrors MA step-therapy law and Section F of the commercial standard form

masshealth.attestation: Signature under 130 CMR 450.204 (pains and penalties of perjury). Hand-signed scan or DocuSign/Adobe Sign image; typed text signature NOT acceptable.
masshealth.fieldNameCaveat: Repeated Yes/No checkboxes are named 'Yes Please list the dates/duration...' with _N suffixes; map suffix -> section by widget position before programmatic fill (resolved for the draft in ../drafts/).

bcbsma.note: Fluticasone propionate HFA is the PREFERRED Tier-1 ICS on BCBSMA Standard Control (July 2026) - no PA exists to draft. The app's job for this payer is the inverse: tell the prescriber no form is needed. If another ICS is blocked, the vehicle is the MA Standard Form via BCBSMA's eForm (see ../forms/bcbsma-ma-standard-pa-form-2024-01.pdf + bcbsma-eform-instructions.pdf).

tufts.scope: Fluticasone propionate HFA is Tier 3 with step therapy (+ age limit: covered without step only through age 6) on Value Direct 3-Tier 2026.

form.title: Massachusetts Standard Form for Medication Prior Authorization Requests (February 2024 v1.0, Tufts-branded)

submission.fax: 617-673-0988 (pre-printed in Section A of the Tufts-branded form, with phone 888-884-2404)
submission.mail: Harvard Pilgrim Health Care/Tufts Health Plan, Pharmacy Utilization Management Department, 1 Wellness Way, Canton, MA 02021-1166

prefill.field: Prior Authorization Step Therapy Formulary Exception

prefill.note: the form itself says payers 'may prepopulate Section A' - the app does the same

prefill.field: Prescribing Clinician / Specialty / NPI / Phone / Secure Fax / POC block
Patient Name / DOB / Member ID / sex assigned at birth / current gender

clinicalQuestions.question: Step-therapy exception: any of the four statutory outs (contraindication/harm; expected ineffectiveness; prior same-class trial discontinued for inefficacy/adverse event; stable on requested drug)
clinicalQuestions.appAssist: Pre-lists the plan's preferred lower-step ICS agents to name in the prior-trial answer: beclomethasone HFA (QVAR generic, Tier 2 preferred), Arnuity Ellipta / QVAR RediHaler (Tier 2)

clinicalQuestions.question: Primary diagnosis + ICD (e.g. J45.40 moderate persistent asthma), previous-therapies table (drug/strength/dates/failure), labs if relevant
clinicalQuestions.appAssist: Previous-therapies rows seeded with the plan's own preferred alternatives, prescriber fills dates/outcomes

harvardpilgrim.scope: Same Point32 pharmacy UM as Tufts; fluticasone propionate HFA Tier 3 + step therapy (+ age limit max 6) on HPHC Select 3T 2026.
harvardpilgrim.prefillNote: Identical 133-field template as the Tufts copy - one field map serves both Point32 lines.

mgb.scope: PA for members >= 12 (covered without PA through age 11). Criteria policy effective 2025-09-10.

approvalPaths: New member continuity: enrolled within last 90 days and already on the drug (samples/PAP excluded)
Asthma diagnosis AND inadequate response/adverse reaction/contraindication to BOTH Arnuity Ellipta and QVAR RediHaler
Asthma diagnosis AND documented need for MDI + spacer (physical dexterity, inspiratory flow, or cognitive status)

form.note: MGB does not publish its own drug-specific request form for this policy; the MA Standard Form + the policy's criteria is the paper path
